# Rapid_Degradation_Dynamics

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The temporal trajectory showing that alignment loss occurs quickly during early training epochs, rather than gradually, when using supervised STDP-based learning. Understanding this rapid onset is crucial for designing early-stopping or regularization strategies in iNEST training pipelines to preserve cortical alignment while still learning tasks.
